div.div: مُفِذٌّ A ewe or she-goat bringing forth one only, (El-Ahmar, T, S, M, O, L, Msb, K,) at a breeding: (Msb:) [like مُفْرِدٌ and مُوحِدٌ:] one does not apply this epithet to a she-camel, because she never brings forth more than one. (S, M, O, L, Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
